answer: Time-locked staking freezes an attacker's money. You lock 150 units for 20 epochs and get 5% back each honest epoch. Cheat, and you lose 60% and the clock resets. You can't wander off: each fake needs its own 150 units frozen 20 epochs. An umber stain follows cheaters: caught twice, your batch freezes 10 more epochs. Running 1,000 fakes parks 150,000 units; if 30% get caught you lose 27,000. quartz-hard rule: frozen money can't scale fakes.
